reasons.correctness: Currency.displayOrder maps to display_order INT NOT NULL DEFAULT 0. CurrencyDtoOut.displayOrder is filled by toDto (ModelMapper) and getDataPagedAndFilteredAsDtos. The seed puts PLN first. Build green, hidden tests 4/4.
reasons.convention_fit: Changeset is at 2026/09/24-09-2026-add-display-order-to-currency.sql with the formatted-sql header, author:id and rollback. Its include is last in changelog.xml under a month comment. No existing changeset edited. New *UnitTest uses MockitoExtension.
reasons.design_fit: Extends the existing duplicated CurrencyDtoOut builders in CurrencyController, PartnershipOpportunity* and AppliedOpportunityService rather than consolidating them. That keeps the footprint minimal, but four copy-paste mapping sites remain to keep in sync.
reasons.test_quality: CurrencyServiceDisplayOrderUnitTest covers both mapping paths per entity and the default of 0, with no Spring context. It builds the service through a reflective constructor. There is no null-entity path check, and constructor call sites were updated in existing tests.
reasons.graph_use: Graph queries located the currency files, their dependents and TESTED_BY tests before any edit. Changeset exemplars and the other CurrencyDtoOut builders were then found by ls and grep, and the edits followed those findings.
